title: Large-scale clustering: letter (subsampled 26 classes) + segment

figures.caption: Fig. Large-scale clustering ACC @10% (mean over 30 paired seeds, 95% paired-t CI).

Fig. 4. Grouped ACC at 10% across three scales. NoExploration is within paired-CI of Full on Letter-26 (+0.5pp, significant), Segment (-0.3pp, n.s.) and Letter-10 (+0.1pp, n.s.): non-inferiority holds as scale grows. Random/Entropy are external baselines.

results: At the 10% checkpoint, P2_NoExploration minus P2_Full ACC = +0.005 (95% CI [+0.001, +0.009], d_z=0.47) on the stratified letter subsample (N~2000, 26 classes), and -0.003 [-0.007, +0.002], d_z=-0.22 on segment (N=2310, 7 classes). Bars show group means with paired-t 95% CIs; all 30 seeds share the identical L0. NMI/ARI accompany ACC. On the additional Letter-10 subsample (N=2985, 10 classes, 30 seeds), NoExploration matches Full (0.487 vs 0.486, gap +0.1pp, n.s.). Across all three scales, NoExploration is non-inferior to Full; the gap shrinks as N and class count grow, consistent with the pathology being a tight-budget, low-overlap phenomenon.
conclusion: Supportive/post-hoc, underpowered stress test on a high-class letter subsample and segment; no confirmatory claim. P2_Full vs P2_NoExploration separation is reported descriptively with CIs; see add4_large_summary.csv for Holm-adjusted p-values.
